title: The Silver Stag Inn
description: A low timber inn at dusk, lantern light in every window, a silver stag on the sign.

title: The lantern hall
description: A long stone hall hung with lanterns, a table set for one.

title: The cellar door
description: A heavy iron-banded door at the foot of a stair.

title: The old map
description: A creased map of the valley on a wooden table.
